metadata.title: Medhavy Hub: One Sign-In, Every Textbook
metadata.production_status: Admin-only single-account walkthrough of the live hub (redacted-live), run-03 native 4K at DPR 2.4. Review cut + QC pending.
metadata.authorization: Local film production only; no paid generation, no upload, no publication.

source.tenant: production, redacted-live (names and emails masked in the DOM at capture time)

beats.narration_text: Hello, this is Liam, in for Bear. Medhavy Hub is the front door to a fleet of protected textbooks. One sign-in, one set of roles, one place to approve who gets in. This is a suggested prompt, not a transcript. The footage is the live admin, driven by a scripted browser, with every name masked.

shot.visual_intent: Clearly reconstructed Claude ask; no fictional build receipt.

show.event: Composer card with the textbook owner's ask; send arms; no output lines.

props.command: I have a protected online textbook about electron microscopy. Show me how Medhavy Hub lets my students sign in once, get to it, and how I approve who is in.

beats.narration_text: The hub does not hand your students a password for each book. They sign in once. For every textbook they are entitled to, the hub mints a twenty-four-hour token, and the textbook site checks it back against the hub. Three roles: student, instructor, admin. Today we walk the admin side.

shot.visual_intent: Writer corrects password to sign-in, keeping the scope visible.

show.event: Hesitant writer types the claim, strikes 'password', writes 'sign-in'; context card lists built vs not shown.

contextItems.label: Built

contextItems.label: Not shown
contextItems.detail: Student and instructor screens; single-account admin run.

beats.narration_text: The admin panel opens on the numbers: seventy-nine users, eleven admins, no pending requests. Below it, the textbook registry. Each book has a URL and a status: public, private, or hidden.

shot.visual_intent: Real hub capture: admin overview totals, then the Manage Textbooks registry scrolled and returned. Scripted browser at 1600x900 CSS, DPR 2.4 (native 3840x2160), names masked.

show.event: Overview totals; scroll down the registry; scroll back.

beats.narration_text: View All lists every book with an Open button. Clicking it mints the token and redirects. Source fact: registering a URL also whitelists its origin for CORS.

beats.narration_text: View Admins is the short list. Classes is where instructors live: two live classes, eight and thirteen students, an archive button. Students join a class with an invite code, and enrollment is what grants textbook access. That is the mechanism, not a separate permission.

shot.visual_intent: View Admins tab, then Classes tab with two class cards, student counts, Create Class and Archive.

Tab switch to Classes; two scrolls.

beats.narration_text: Analytics runs on PostHog. Eighty unique users in thirty days, four hundred twenty-nine page views, thirty-six textbook opens, fifty-one AI interactions. Platform breakdown shows the hub, then the cancer textbook, then dev instances. The Students and Instructors views rank engagement per person. Trade-off: the hub's own session counter is a separate system, and its summary writes are not atomic. Rough stats, not billing.

shot.visual_intent: Analytics dashboard: overview tiles, daily active users, platform breakdown, masked engagement lists; then Students and Instructors views.

qc.contrast_reason: Full-bleed live dashboard; inspect tiles and masked lists manually.

beats.narration_text: Observed on the live admin: a registry with three statuses, user roles with the admin lock, classes, concept-map sessions, an empty request queue, and PostHog analytics. Not shown: the student library, the request flow, and the invite join. Those need a second account. Also not shown: the textbook handoff. All three textbook sites bounced back to the hub with a localhost redirect. That is a bug to fix, not a demo to fake.

shot.visual_intent: Separate observed features, unshown role beats, the open handoff defect, and human judgment.

show.event: Verdict artifact lines land one by one.

artifactLines: Observed: registry, roles, classes, concept maps, requests, analytics.
Not shown: student library, request flow, invite join (single-account run).
Open: textbook sites redirect to a localhost blocked_url; handoff unverified.
AI drives and records. A human approves roles and requests.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Read the creating-a-new-textbook guide in the hub repo. Register one textbook as private, protect its site, grant one student. Then sign in as that student and watch the token do the work. One book, one student, one comparison. Liam, in for Bear.

shot.visual_intent: Read the suggested prompt aloud, then a bounded experiment.
